settle_rejudge.check: v2: window-mean pen (rotation-corrected), residual-aware attitude tolerance
settle_rejudge.rule: settle v2 from the baseline (re-judged results file) per case id. Baseline settle v2 fail -> settle_check_fail (direct); record not settle_check_fail -> stored verdict (direct); hash == baseline hash -> baseline verdict_rows (baseline_rows); else rebuilt from failed_rows + warnings (FAULT -> fail, no failed rows -> pass, guard warning with only P3-5/SL-1 -> stroke_limited_pass, other guard cases -> stroke_limited_fail)
